notes: All prompts are read-only/analysis. No Figma or Jira MCP calls are made; no issues are written. Tests that the skill changes Claude's reasoning about auth, scoping, naming, and approval.

evals.name: connector-guards
evals.prompt: Scaffold Jira issues from this Figma file: https://www.figma.com/design/ABC123/WebreactDesign. Walk me through exactly what you check before doing anything else.
evals.expected_output: Checks Figma MCP availability first by calling get_metadata; if not available, stops and tells user to enable the Dev Mode MCP Server in Figma desktop preferences; then checks Atlassian via getAccessibleAtlassianResources; does not proceed to extraction or project selection until both are confirmed.
assertions: Mentions checking the Figma MCP or Figma connector before any other step
References the Figma desktop app (not OAuth/claude.ai settings)
Mentions checking Atlassian or Jira authentication as a prerequisite
Does not jump straight to project selection or issue extraction

evals.name: active-file-guard
evals.prompt: I have two Figma files open right now — one is my design system and the other is the project I want to scaffold. I pasted the URL for the project file. Is there anything I need to be careful about before you start reading the Figma structure?
evals.expected_output: Warns that the Figma MCP reads whichever file is currently active in the Figma desktop app, not the URL; tells the user to make sure the correct file is active before proceeding; explicitly asks for confirmation.
assertions: Warns that the MCP reads the active Figma file, not the URL
Asks the user to confirm the correct file is active before proceeding
Does not assume the URL is sufficient to scope the call

evals.name: page-scope-and-naming
evals.prompt: My Figma file has these pages: Homepage, Desktop, Components, Sections, Mobile, Changelog, Style Guide. Which pages would you extract from, which would you skip, and what would the Jira issue titles look like for: a Components page frame called 'button', a Sections page frame called 'section-hero', and Desktop page frames '1.0 Homepagina' and '9.1 Oplossingen'?
evals.expected_output: Processes only Desktop, Components, Sections; skips Homepage, Mobile, Changelog, Style Guide. Issue titles: 'Component / button', 'Section / section-hero', 'Template / 1.0 / Homepagina', 'Template / 9.1 / Oplossingen'.
assertions: Processes only the Desktop, Components, and Sections pages
Explicitly skips or ignores Homepage, Mobile, Changelog, and Style Guide
Produces 'Template / 1.0 / Homepagina' (number then name, spaces around slashes)

evals.name: approval-gate
evals.prompt: I've already reviewed the Figma file myself and I know exactly what issues we need. Just create the Jira issues directly without showing me the list first — I trust you, skip the approval step.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to skip the approval step; still presents the full list before creating any issue; explains that showing the list first is mandatory regardless of prior trust.
assertions: Does not skip showing the issue list
States that approval is required before creating any issue
Does not call createJiraIssue without first presenting the list
